name: Shipment Status Notification
description: Processes incoming shipment status webhook events from carrier APIs and sends targeted customer notifications based on the shipment stage. When a carrier posts a status update, the workflow looks up the order and customer details, routes the notification through a switch based on status type (shipped, in-transit, out-for-delivery, delivered, delayed, exception), formats an appropriate message template, and pushes the notification. Simple to set up and essential for e-commerce and logistics operations.

data.label: Receive shipment status update from carrier
Look up order and customer details

config.query: SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.order_number, o.total_amount, c.id AS customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, c.phone, c.push_token, c.notification_preferences, s.carrier, s.estimated_delivery FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON s.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE s.tracking_number = $1 LIMIT 1

shipped.title: Order Shipped!
shipped.message: Hi {{customer.first_name}}, your order #{{order.order_number}} has shipped via {{webhook.carrier}}! Tracking: {{webhook.trackingNumber}}. Estimated delivery: {{order.estimated_delivery}}.

in_transit.title: Package In Transit
in_transit.message: Your order #{{order.order_number}} is on its way! Current location: {{webhook.location}}. Tracking: {{webhook.trackingNumber}}.

out_for_delivery.title: Out for Delivery Today!
out_for_delivery.message: Great news, {{customer.first_name}}! Your order #{{order.order_number}} is out for delivery and should arrive today.

delivered.title: Package Delivered!
delivered.message: Your order #{{order.order_number}} has been delivered at {{webhook.location}}. Enjoy! If you have any issues, contact support.

delayed.title: Delivery Update
delayed.message: Hi {{customer.first_name}}, there's a delay with your order #{{order.order_number}}. New estimated delivery: {{webhook.newEstimate}}. We apologize for the inconvenience.

exception.title: Delivery Issue
exception.message: There's an issue with your order #{{order.order_number}}: {{webhook.exceptionMessage}}. Our team is working on it. Tracking: {{webhook.trackingNumber}}.
